title: Item Modification
description: A comprehensive schema for item modifications with narrative integration, LLM-GM guidance, and enhanced mechanics.

name.description: The display name of the modification.

mod_type.description: The primary category of items this modification can be applied to.

era.description: The primary era this modification is most associated with, e.g., 'Galactic_Republic', 'Galactic_Empire', 'New_Republic'.

narrative.description: Rich narrative description of the modification, its significance, and role in the galaxy. Used by LLM-GM for storytelling.

flavor_text.description: Iconic quote, description, or memorable phrase that captures the essence of this modification.

cultural_significance.description: Description of how this modification is viewed and valued by different cultures and groups in the galaxy.

description.description: Tooltip text explaining the modification's effects and requirements.

installation_process.description: Detailed step-by-step description of how the modification is installed.

origin_story.description: The history and origin of this modification technique or design.

connections.description: Universal connections to any game object - factions, species, classes, locations, etc.

target_id.description: ID of the target object (faction, species, class, location, etc.).

target_type.description: The type of object being connected to.

relationship.description: The nature of the relationship, e.g., 'Developed By', 'Common Among', 'Restricted To', 'Iconic To', 'Enhanced By'.

narrative.description: Description of how these objects are connected.

mechanical_benefit.description: Optional mechanical benefit from this connection.

iconic_examples.description: Famous or notable examples of this modification from Star Wars canon.

famous_users.description: Notable individuals who have used this modification.

famous_instances.description: Notable events or moments involving this modification.

narrative_hooks.description: Story hooks and narrative elements related to this modification.

adventure_seeds.description: Potential adventure ideas that could involve this modification.

character_connections.description: Ways characters might be connected to or affected by this modification.

typical_usage.description: Examples of how this modification is typically used in Star Wars stories.

cultural_impact.description: How this modification affects the cultures and societies of the galaxy.

technological_significance.description: The technological implications and significance of this modification.

slot_cost.description: How many modification slots (Hard Points) this modification consumes when installed.

compatible_items.description: Tags that items must have to be compatible with this modification.

prerequisites.description: Requirements that must be met before this modification can be installed.

skill.description: Skill required for installation (e.g., 'Technology (INT)', 'Dexterity (Sleight of Hand)').

dc.description: Difficulty class for the installation check.

time.description: Time required for installation (e.g., '1 hour', '4 hours').

mechanics.description: The mechanical effects this modification provides when installed.

effect.description: The type of effect this modification provides.

modification.description: How this modification changes the target property (e.g., 'increase_die_size_by_one_step', 'add_plus_2_bonus').

narrative.description: Description of how the modification affects the item's appearance or behavior.

parameters.description: Additional parameters for the modification effect.

image_generation.description: Data source for modular AI art generation engine.

base_prompt.description: Detailed foundational prompt for generating a 'stock image' of this modification, with bracketed placeholders for customizable parts.

contextual_modifiers.description: Modifiers defining how this modification adds flavor and context to other image prompts.

target_type.description: The type of image this modifier applies to (e.g., 'Item_Display', 'Installation_Scene', 'Character_Portrait').

modifier_text.description: Text to append to the base prompt when this modification is part of the context.

ui.description: User interface assets and display information.

image.description: Path to the modification's representative image.

icon.description: Path to the modification's icon for UI display.

themes.description: Thematic elements associated with this modification.

mood.description: The emotional tone or atmosphere associated with this modification.
